body.title: A little chopping. A lot of good.
body.description:
Help turn surplus ingredients into a shared neighbourhood lunch. You’ll wash and chop vegetables, set the tables and help clear up afterwards.

You’ll work alongside our kitchen lead and a small, friendly team. No kitchen experience needed. We’ll make time to sit down and eat together at the end.
body.requirements: Wear closed-toe shoes and clothes you can cook in. A food-safety briefing is included on arrival.
body.accessibility: Step-free entrance and accessible toilet. Seated food preparation available.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo organisation bringing neighbours together over fresh food.

body.title: Give the garden a Saturday.
body.description:
Spend a morning outdoors preparing beds, planting seasonal bulbs and making our shared garden ready for autumn.

Choose a task that suits you, from light planting to moving compost. We supply the tools, gloves and tea. First-timers are very welcome.
body.address: Demo venue · Cambridge Heath Road, Bethnal Green
body.requirements: Bring sturdy shoes and a waterproof layer. Tools and a short safety introduction are provided.
body.accessibility: Level paved entrance. Some beds are reached across uneven ground; seated tasks are available.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo group caring for shared green spaces in East London.

body.title: Good food, going to good homes.
body.description:
Sort donated groceries and pack balanced food bags ready for collection by local households.

Our shift leader will show you the sorting stations and pair you with an experienced volunteer. It’s practical, sociable work with a clear finish.
body.requirements: Closed-toe shoes. Please tell us about any lifting limitations in your request.
body.accessibility: Step-free warehouse with accessible toilet. Some tasks involve lifting; lighter alternatives are available.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo organisation bringing neighbours together over fresh food.

body.title: Help the next chapter find a reader.
body.description:
Join our evening book-sorting session. Check donations, organise shelves and help prepare a welcoming community book swap.

If you love a good browse, you’ll fit right in. We’ll finish with a cup of tea and a recommendation or two.
body.requirements: No preparation needed. An introduction is included when you arrive.
body.accessibility: Step-free space. Sorting can be done sitting or standing.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo community group giving everyday things a second life.

body.title: A cleaner canal. A better morning.
body.description:
Take a gentle walk along the canal and help collect litter from the towpath. You’ll be in a small group with an experienced session leader.

We provide litter pickers, gloves and bags. Stay on the towpath throughout; there is no work in the water.
body.address: Demo meeting point · White Post Lane, Hackney Wick
body.requirements: Wear sturdy shoes and weather-appropriate clothing. Safety briefing before we set off.
body.accessibility: Towpath includes uneven surfaces and narrow sections. Contact the host through your request about access needs.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo group caring for shared green spaces in East London.

body.title: Make a useful thing useful again.
body.description:
Help our reuse team clean, photograph and organise donated household items so they can be passed on locally.

You don’t need repair skills. This session focuses on preparation and sorting; electrical work is left to qualified people.
body.requirements: Wear clothes you don’t mind getting dusty. All equipment is provided.
body.accessibility: Step-free entrance. A quiet work area and seated tasks are available.
body.organisation_description: A fictional demo community group giving everyday things a second life.
